mapper.select: SELECT ci.collection_item_id AS collectionItemId, rg.region_group_code AS regionGroupCode, rg.region_group_name AS regionGroupName, ci.item_name AS itemName, ci.item_type AS itemType, ci.image_url AS imageUrl, ci.description AS description, CASE WHEN mrci.rel_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS acquiredYn, mrci.created_at AS acquiredAt FROM collection_item ci JOIN region_group rg ON rg.region_group_id = ci.region_group_id LEFT JOIN member_rel_collection_item mrci ON mrci.collection_item_id = ci.collection_item_id AND mrci.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE ci.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY rg.sort_order ASC

SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.badge_group AS badgeGroup, b.badge_code AS badgeCode, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.description AS description, b.target_count AS targetCount, COALESCE(mrb.current_count, 0) AS currentCount, COALESCE(mrb.achieved_yn, 'N') AS achievedYn, mrb.achieved_at AS achievedAt FROM badge b LEFT JOIN member_rel_badge mrb ON mrb.badge_id = b.badge_id AND mrb.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY b.badge_id ASC
SELECT collection_item_id FROM collection_item WHERE region_group_id = #{regionGroupId} AND use_yn = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_rel_collection_item( member_id, collection_item_id, trip_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{collectionItemId}, #{tripId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT badge_id AS badgeId, target_count AS targetCount FROM badge WHERE badge_code = #{badgeCode} AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT current_count AS currentCount, achieved_yn AS achievedYn, achieved_at AS achievedAt FROM member_rel_badge WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND badge_id = #{badgeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_rel_badge( member_id, badge_id, current_count, achieved_yn, achieved_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{badgeId}, #{currentCount}, #{achievedYn}, #{achievedAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_rel_badge SET current_count = #{currentCount}, achieved_yn = #{achievedYn}, achieved_at = #{achievedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND badge_id = #{badgeId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM member_rel_trip WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'JOINED'

SELECT rg.region_group_id AS regionGroupId, rg.region_group_code AS regionGroupCode FROM trip t INNER JOIN trip_region tr ON tr.trip_region_id = t.trip_region_id INNER JOIN region_group rg ON rg.region_group_id = tr.region_group_id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId}

SELECT rg.region_group_id AS regionGroupId, COUNT(*) AS visitCount FROM member_rel_trip mrt INNER JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = mrt.trip_id INNER JOIN trip_region tr ON tr.trip_region_id = t.trip_region_id INNER JOIN region_group rg ON rg.region_group_id = tr.region_group_id WHERE mrt.member_id = #{memberId} AND mrt.status = 'JOINED' AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY rg.region_group_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_mission WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_mission tm INNER JOIN mission m ON m.mission_id = tm.mission_id WHERE tm.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tm.status = 'COMPLETED' AND m.mission_type = #{missionType}
SELECT member_id AS memberId, COUNT(*) AS diaryCount FROM diary WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} GROUP BY member_id
